entities.name: Prophecy
entities.description: The final novel of the Masquerade Cycle, a stand-alone story of the Keldon invasion of Jamuraa set shortly before the Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria.

entities.name: Keldons
entities.description: Invaders who landed in the north of Jamuraa seeking ancestral land and Hero's Blood.

entities.name: Kipamu League
entities.description: The Jamuraan league of city-states defending against the Keldons, lacking unified leadership.

entities.name: Jamuraa
entities.description: The continent invaded by the Keldons.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker enlisted to aid the League, who sends Barrin and later questions his role.

entities.name: Haddad
entities.description: A Kipamu League soldier enslaved by the Keldons; he dies at the story's end.

entities.name: Latulla
entities.description: A Keldon overseer obsessed with prophecy and conquest, exiled and finally executed by Barrin.

entities.name: Greel
entities.description: A life-draining horror employed by Latulla whose powers fuel Keldon artifacts and war machines.

entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: The Master Wizard dispatched by Teferi to aid the League; husband of Rayne.

entities.name: Rayne
entities.description: Barrin's wife, an accomplished artificer, killed by Greel.

entities.name: Jolrael
entities.description: A reclusive wizard who supports the League.

entities.name: Gorsha
entities.description: A representative of the Keldon Warlords' Council who defeats Latulla in ritual combat.

entities.name: Keldon Warlords' Council
entities.description: The Keldon council that denounced Latulla's actions and exiled her.

entities.name: Witch-Kings
entities.description: Ancient Keldon figures in the Necropolis whom Latulla tried to awaken.

entities.name: Keldon Necropolis
entities.description: The resting place of the Witch-Kings in Keld.

entities.name: Hero's Blood
entities.description: A magical resource the Keldons seek, known as tufa in Jamuraa.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Leader whose distant leadership disillusions Barrin and Teferi.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria
entities.description: The invasion that follows shortly after the novel.

events.summary: Haddad faces a band of Keldons led by Overseer Latulla and is enslaved.
events.quote: Haddad is enslaved and learns more about the culture of his captors.

events.summary: The Keldons initiate brutal raids on the League cities, pushing the League toward the coast.
events.quote: The League, lacking unified leadership, suffers heavy losses and is pushed toward the coast.

events.summary: Latulla employs Greel, a life-draining horror whose powers fuel Keldon war machines.
events.quote: Latulla employs the services of Greel

events.summary: Teferi dispatches Barrin, who coordinates defenses and introduces magical airships, joined by Rayne, Mageta and Jolrael.
events.quote: Teferi dispatches Barrin , the Master Wizard, to aid the Kipamu League.

events.summary: Latulla returns to Keld to awaken the Witch-Kings, is stopped by Gorsha, defeated in ritual combat, and exiled by the Council.
events.quote: The two engage in ritual combat, and Latulla is defeated.

events.summary: Latulla leads a final assault, is pinned beneath her overturned war barge, demands Barrin's help, and Barrin, grieving Rayne's death at Greel's hands, executes her.
The Keldons are defeated and their colonies destroyed; Rayne, Latulla, Greel and Haddad die, and Barrin and Teferi begin to question their roles.
events.quote: The story ends with the defeat of the Keldons, the destruction of their colonies in Jamuraa
